correctness.rationale: The covariance lower bound and its equality conditions are reconstructed explicitly. Equality yields \(\mathbb E[\widetilde X\mid T]=aT\); boundedness makes the noise characteristic function entire. The differential identity \((1-a)\phi_X\prime\phi_Y=a\phi_X\phi_Y\prime\) and a simple Bernoulli characteristic-function zero force integer multiplicity \((1-a)/a=v/\sigma^2\), after which the quotient argument identifies the noise as the corresponding convolution power. Integer attainment is exact by exchangeability. Huang existence converts pointwise nonattainment into strict infimum inequality. The checker uses exact arithmetic only as supplemental consistency evidence.

originality.rationale: The source gives integer-multiple optimizers but not an only-if sharpness spectrum. Targeted published-finding corpus and literature searches found no covering statement. Classical regression characterizations were treated as the main equivalence risk and, in the inspected material, require additional conditional-law structure rather than only Bernoulli signal independence and a variance budget.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact set of variance budgets where a universal lower bound solves the Bernoulli least-favorable-noise problem and classifies every equality law. It gives a structural divisibility obstruction explaining why the source's convolution solution cannot interpolate through noninteger budgets, while leaving the genuinely harder exact noninteger optimizer problem explicit.
